name: kyle-darling
description: Claude Code Desktop mods by Kyle Darling

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A live task HUD for Claude Code Desktop: a strip above the prompt while Claude works, with a full dashboard one click away.

plugins.name: hud-git
plugins.description: A source for the HUD: the session's git branch, with files changed and how far ahead or behind. Needs the hud plugin.

plugins.name: hud-ci
plugins.description: A source for the HUD: whether your branch's GitHub Actions run is running, passed or failed after you push. Needs the hud plugin and a signed-in gh.
